infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: KiddoCare uses the camera so a parent can add a photo for a communication tile.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: KiddoCare uses the microphone so a child can speak a word or sentence.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: KiddoCare turns a spoken word or sentence into text and a matching picture, on the device.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: KiddoCare lets a parent pick a photo from the gallery for a communication tile.
